subject: Possibility to provide custom epsilon for light and glow for spatial move optimization
rationale: The originally-cited risk (probe-GI/LightProbeGrid.cpp calling these light-update methods) doesn't hold up: grepped LightProbeGrid.cpp/.h directly, it never calls set_position()/set_rotation() at all. Real issue found instead: the commit defaults light's new eps param to EPS (0.00001) in both Render.h and light.h, not EPS_L (0.001) which light::set_position/set_rotation currently hardcode internally - Glow correctly preserves EPS_L as its default, light does not (likely an oversight). Every existing call site (Light_DB.cpp x6, light.cpp's internal light-copy update) calls without an explicit eps, so taking this as-authored would silently tighten the move-detection threshold 100x for every dynamic light, causing more frequent spatial_move()/shadow re-registration - a frame-time regression, opposite of the commit's stated purpose. Take, but requires a one-line fix during cherry-pick: change '= EPS' to '= EPS_L' in the light set_position/set_rotation declarations (Render.h, light.h) to match original behavior for unmodified callers; the opt-in custom-epsilon capability itself is fine once that's corrected.
review_notes: Verified: adds opt-in eps param to light::set_position/set_rotation and CGlow::set_position. Confirmed real bug beyond triage's note: Render.h/light.h default the new light eps to EPS (1e-5) instead of EPS_L (1e-3, the value the old hardcoded body used) - Glow's default correctly stays EPS_L. Every existing caller (Light_DB.cpp x6, internal copy-update in light.cpp) omits the arg, so as-authored this silently tightens move-detection 100x for all dynamic lights (more frequent spatial_move()/shadow re-registration - a frame-time regression). Fix during cherry-pick: change light::set_position/set_rotation defaults from EPS to EPS_L in Render.h and light.h. Also confirmed LightProbeGrid.cpp never calls set_position()/set_rotation() at all, so the GI-overlap concern doesn't hold up.

review_flags.note: Upstream authored the eps default as EPS instead of EPS_L for light::set_position/set_rotation (Render.h + light.h), a 100x tighter default move-detection threshold than existing behavior for every unmodified caller. Must patch to EPS_L during cherry-pick.

If cherry-picked as-authored (EPS default, not corrected to EPS_L), dynamic lights would re-register shadows far more often on tiny position changes - a potential frame-time regression a player could notice as stutter. Verify after the EPS_L fix is applied.
